subject: Stakeholder trajectory & MAP seed: kickoff + draft GDoc
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Marsh <elaine.m@lumentx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder trajectory & MAP seed: kickoff + draft GDoc

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I’m sharing a compact seed of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short kickoff slide deck so we can align stakeholders and sprint the pilot. Links / stubs below; the GDoc is editable and I’ve left a few sections for your team to populate (acceptance criteria, success metrics).

Attachments / links:
- Lumen-MAP-template-v1.gdoc (editable) — contains week0-week4 milestones, owners, and acceptance matrix
- week0-kickoff-slides.pptx — 6-slide intro + suggested kickoff agenda

High-level proposed timeline (suggested):
- Week 0: kickoff, environment access, point-of-contact alignment, security intake
- Week 1: test dataset ingestion, smoke tests, model selection for pilot workload
- Week 2: integration + latency validation, metric baseline capture
- Week 3: acceptance tests, quality tuning, stakeholder review
- Week 4: pilot wrap, acceptance sign-off, next-step decision

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the two primary stakeholders who will own acceptance sign-off?
2) Does the week0 kickoff on Tue 12/15 at 10:00 AM PT work for you? (30 min)
3) Any immediate compliance asks we should prep for prior to kickoff?

If 12/15 works I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and internal owners.

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

—Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0114


From: Elaine Marsh <elaine.m@lumentx.com>

Jordan —

Thanks for the share and the clear timeline. The GDoc looks like a good starting point. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Primary stakeholders for acceptance will be me (Product) and Raj Patel (IT Security) — I’ve cc’d Raj here.
- We have a standing compliance window this quarter; before kickoff Raj will ask for an explicit SOC 2 statement and a short list of where logs/retention are surfaced.
- Tue 12/15 at 10:00 AM PT should work for a 30-min kickoff — please send the invite.

One ask on the MAP doc: can you add a short row for "data residency / access" and a column for "required evidence"? That will help our procurement folks.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — see you on 12/15.

Thanks,
Elaine Marsh
Head of Product, Lumen Therapeutics
elaine.m@lumentx.com

Hi all —

Nice kickoff today. Quick notes and agreed next steps (pulled from the MAP doc and our short call):

Meeting notes:
- Attendees: Elaine (Lumen Product), Raj (Lumen IT Sec), Jordan (Redwood SE), Marissa (Redwood AM), Ben (Redwood Infra)
- Goal: validate pilot timeline, confirm evidence for security/compliance, and lock week0 ownership

Decisions / actions:

4) Acceptance sign-off: Elaine + Raj to execute acceptance checks during Week 3; acceptance criteria table updated in the GDoc (column completed).

Follow-ups:
- Jordan to update MAP GDoc with access stub + evidence links (done).
- Marissa to create weekly cadence invite (recurring Wed standup) and add acceptance checkpoints.
- Elaine to confirm procurement/PO timeline by 12/22.

Attachments / links from today:
